title: Useful Add-ons
body: Optional upgrades should solve a real fit, service, or riding problem. Use the list below as a quick check before adding parts to a custom wheelset order.

tubeless.title: Tubeless setup
tubeless.body: Rim tape, valves, and sealant for riders who want lower pressure and puncture resistance.

spareSpokes.title: Spare spokes
spareSpokes.body: Helpful for travel, racing, or less common spoke lengths that may be hard to source locally.

freehub.title: Freehub body
freehub.body: Only add a spare or alternate freehub body after confirming cassette compatibility.

logo.title: Logo finish
logo.body: Laser engraving is the fastest low-maintenance choice; decals suit custom team colors.
